title: Visa Estimated and Incremental Authorization Transactions
applicability: Applies to Visa card-not-present Segment 100 transactions for MCC 4121/5411 (estimated/incremental) and MCC 5552 (EV incremental), and their subsequent incremental authorizations.

businessRequirements.title: Estimated and Incremental Authorization is permitted only for MCC 4121 and 5411 (card-not-present) and MCC 5552 (EV transactions).
An estimated/initial authorization request for a permitted merchant shall include the estimated authorization indicator (Acquirer Trace Data Sub Table ID 09) when the final amount is unknown.

An incremental authorization request shall follow an estimated/initial authorization, must not resend the estimated-authorization indicator, and must carry the same Sequence Number, Transaction Identifier, and Terminal Transaction Number (Segment 111 Table ID 63) as the original estimated/initial request.

An estimated authorization and its incremental authorizations expire 14 days after the initial estimated authorization for cruise/lodging/vehicle-rental merchants, or 7 days for other rental merchants, after which the merchant is subject to chargeback unless completion is initiated within that window.
